# thermal — Chrome

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build.lua -- do not edit -->

A dark browser theme: the frame behind the tabs is the darkest smoke, the
toolbar is a raised smoke surface a step lighter, and the heat -- amber -- lands
only on new-tab links. Colours are baked in, so there is no dependency and
nothing is fetched.

The toolbar being lighter than the frame is deliberate: Chrome has no
"selected tab" colour, so it paints multi-selected (and active) tabs with the
toolbar colour and unselected tabs with the frame colour. The gap between the
two is what makes a multi-tab selection visible.

## Install (unpacked)

1. Open `chrome://extensions`.
2. Turn on **Developer mode** (top right).
3. **Load unpacked**, and pick one flavour's directory:

```
chrome/thermal-smoky
```

Available: `chrome/thermal-smoky`, `chrome/thermal-void`, `chrome/thermal-ash`.

Chrome allows one theme at a time; loading a flavour replaces the last. To
remove it, `chrome://extensions` → Remove, or set another theme.

Unpacked themes don't auto-update. After a palette edit and `make build`, go to
`chrome://extensions` and hit the reload arrow on the theme's card.

## Pack a `.crx` (optional)

For a single distributable file: `chrome://extensions` → **Pack extension**,
point at `chrome/thermal-smoky`, and Chrome writes a `.crx` next to it.
